lead.headline: McLaurin's hamstring is still unsettled — and you have already benched him for Allgeier
lead.deck: A 12.4-to-12.4 coin flip, set in the only order that keeps a fallback. Nothing to do before Sunday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin was limited Thursday and sat out Friday; Washington call it rest, but at seven on Saturday morning they had still not published designations. You settled it overnight: Coker to receiver, Allgeier to the flex, McLaurin to the bench. The projection cannot split them, 12.4 each, and the clock can: Allgeier plays Sunday at the Rams with Jeremiyah Love ruled out, McLaurin Monday night, so starting Allgeier means there is never a Monday zero to fix. Pittsburgh's Rico Dowdle is back and questionable after two full practices, which trims Warren's share; ESPN already has it in Warren's 15.0. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0 against Bok-aneers' 112.5.
